source.name: The Drive - How to Buy a Classic Jeep: The Complete Buyer's Guide (David Traver Adolphus, 2016)
source.says: 1955-1983 CJ-5 and 20-inch longer 1956-1975 CJ-6 "generally shared the same mechanical options - the Hurricane four-cylinder available through 1971; and the optional Dauntless V6 from the 1966 model year on"; in 1972 "bigger AMC straight-sixes and their 304 V8 were introduced". No hp figures given.

note: Confirms engine availability in CJ-6 (shared CJ-5/CJ-6 options, AMC engines from 1972, CJ-6 through 1975); does not state hp.
